description: Breezell's title bar shows what the agent is doing in a capsule that morphs. Leave Breezell while it works and it floats at the top of the screen, above every app, and opens into a panel of your conversations; come back and it flies into the title bar.
config.floatOutside: Float the island at the top of the screen, above other apps, when you leave Breezell or minimize it while something is going on. On Linux this needs an X11 session; under Wayland the island stays in the title bar.
